openChange.when: The popover opens or closes because of the user: trigger activation, Escape, a press outside, focus leaving it.

rules: A popover is a non-modal panel anchored to a trigger, holding free content the user may interact with (a short form, filters, details, a color choice). The rest of the page stays usable. A list of actions is a Menu; a task that must be completed or abandoned before going on is a Dialog; a short text on hover is a Tooltip.
trigger is exactly one Button or IconButton; activating it toggles the popover. The trigger exposes that it controls a popup and whether it is expanded.
The panel is exposed as a non-modal dialog whose accessible name is label (often the visible heading of the content).

panel is painted in surface with shadow, an edge of borderWidth in elevationColor and radius corners; content inside it has padding and is set in typography and content by default. Its inline size follows the content up to maxInlineSize, and the available viewport inline size when smaller; its block size follows the content and scrolls within the viewport when longer.

The panel is placed at offset from the trigger on side, aligned with the trigger's start, center or end in the reading direction; it flips to the other side and shifts along the edge when the viewport lacks room, and follows the trigger when the page scrolls.

On opening, focus moves to the first focusable element of the content, or to the panel itself when the content has none. The panel follows the trigger in sequential focus order, so that Tab from the trigger enters it and Tab from its last element leaves it.

The popover closes on Escape (focus returns to the trigger), on a press outside the panel and the trigger, and when focus moves outside both (focus stays where it went). Opening a popover closes the popovers that do not contain it; a popover opened inside another stays open with it and closes first on Escape.

The panel inherits the brand, appearance and density of the trigger's surroundings and appears above the page without moving focus out of it. Where the platform has no top layer, it is stacked at layer.

It enters by fading in and moving enterDistance away from the trigger over motionDuration with easingEnter and leaves by fading out over motionDuration with easingExit; under reduced motion it only fades.
Setting open from the application shows or hides the popover without emitting openChange.
In forced-colors mode the panel keeps a visible edge in the system text color.
